productionConfigEvidence.cashFlowSeparation: preview_claim remains Accrued Rewards. Historical realised income is a separate event-attributed plane and is never inferred from a decrease in claimable value.

upstreamSourceEvidence.claimEvent: Claim(address indexed user, IERC20 indexed token, uint256 amount)
upstreamSourceEvidence.semanticObservation: _claim transfers the payout token to the receiver and then emits Claim(user=user, token=token, amount=amount).

officialAddressBinding.observation: The official Yield Basis script sets FEE_DISTRIBUTOR to 0xD11b...7A90 and binds contracts/dao/FeeDistributor.vy at that address.

deploymentBinding.liveRule: Every run fetches the deployment transaction receipt, requires status=1 and contractAddress equal to the configured FeeDistributor, derives the scan start from that receipt, and verifies current runtime code before scanning.
deploymentBinding.reason: v0.2.1 does not claim compiler-reproduced bytecode equivalence. It requires official source semantics, official repository address binding, a successful exact deployment receipt, runtime code, and then each counted Claim must have an exact same-transaction ERC20 payout from the configured contract.

liveCandidateContract.scanHorizon: receipt-derived FeeDistributor deployment block through the exact latest Ethereum block of each run
liveCandidateContract.scanCompletenessRule: The direct-Claim lane is complete only when the deployment receipt is proven and every block from that receipt block through scan.toBlock has been queried successfully; RPC gaps fail closed.
liveCandidateContract.semanticRequirement: Claim.user must equal an exact canonical company wallet
liveCandidateContract.receiptRequirement: same successful transaction must contain exactly one ERC20 Transfer of the same token and raw amount from FeeDistributor to that exact company wallet

diagnosticLearning.initialGenesisScanFailure: A public Ethereum RPC rejected archive eth_getLogs from genesis with HTTP 403 even though current network/deployment reads worked.
diagnosticLearning.architecturalCorrection: Do not weaken RPC/economic guards. Derive the earliest possible event horizon from the exact successful contract-creation receipt instead of querying impossible pre-deployment history.
diagnosticLearning.durableImpact: Lower RPC load while increasing provenance quality: history now starts from a transaction-proven contract existence boundary rather than an arbitrary block 0 assumption.

remainingExpansionRequirements: add other protocol-attributed payout mechanisms one at a time
add vesting/cliff Yield Basis ownership only when economic beneficiary attribution is independently proved
add block/timestamp-bound historical valuation only where methodology is reproducible
do not promote company-wide Realised Cash Flow to measured until declared economic coverage is actually complete
